item.title: 2002 Lexus LS430 at No Reserve
item.description: This 2002 Lexus LS430 remained in the care of the original owner's family until earlier this year. It is finished in Millennium Silver Metallic over Light Charcoal leather and is powered by a 4.3-liter V8 linked to a five-speed automatic transmission. Equipment includes a sunroof, keyless entry, 16" narrow seven-spoke alloy wheels, heated power-adjustable front seats, heated rear seats, an in-dash CD changer, cruise control, and dual-zone automatic climate control. item.description: This 1978 Chevrolet Corvette is powered by a replacement 350ci V8 that has been fitted with a revised camshaft, an HEI distributor, and an Edelbrock four-barrel carburetor and intake manifold. item.title: 2023 Hennessey Venom F5 Roadster
item.description: This 2023 Hennessey Venom F5 is the fifth of a planned 30 roadster variants produced by Hennessey Special Vehicles of Texas. item.title: 1913 Pope-Hartford Model 31 Four-Passenger Phaeton
item.description: This 1913 Pope-Hartford Model 31 is a four-passenger phaeton that is said to have spent several decades in California, where it was purchased by the father of its previous owner in the 1990s. Wearing an older refurbishment, the car is said to have participated in Horseless Carriage Club tours over the years before being purchased by its current owner approximately a month ago. item.title: 9k-Mile 1988.5 Ferrari 328 GTS
item.description: This 1988.5 Ferrari 328 is one of approximately 6,068 removable-top GTS examples produced, and it shows 9k miles following registration history in Florida. The car is finished in Argento Nurburgring Metallizzato over blue leather upholstery, and power is provided by a fuel-injected 3.2-liter V8 paired with a five-speed manual transaxle and a limited-slip differential. item.title: Original-Owner 2005 Ford GT
item.description: This 2005 Ford GT is one of 2,022 built for the model year, and it was purchased new by the current owner, who took delivery of it through Ford of Kenly, North Carolina, and has kept it in their collection. Indicating 4,100 miles, the car was ordered with all four factory options including painted white stripes for the Mark IV Red-finished bodywork as well as forged aluminum BBS wheels, red-finished brake calipers, and a McIntosh stereo system. item.title: 1,500-Kilometer 1990 Lamborghini Countach 25th Anniversary
item.description: This 1990 Lamborghini Countach is one of a claimed 658 examples of the 25th Anniversary variant built during a three-year production run. Chassis LA12666 was sold new in the US and relocated to Canada in 2023 before being returned to the country in March 2025.
